name: assistant
description: Assistant memory in one skill: a dynamic tree of linked Markdown notes about the user (branches are created as new topics appear, each linked from its parent INDEX.md), plus the .claude/ project-memory flow for coding projects (index, agent rules, sessions, tasks, decisions, architecture, code map). Works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop or any AI that can read and write files. Plain files in ~/.assistant/memory/, low context.
